wheat.whyThisCrop: Empirically validated with 45 records in the dataset. Excellent compatibility with alluvial, black_alluvial soil and strong APMC mandi prices averaging ₹5,500/quintal.
nextSteps: Follow dose: Urea @ 230.3 kg/ha (Target N:106, P:45, K:48)

growingGuide.seedRate: Standard certified seed rate for Wheat
growingGuide.landPrep: Plough thoroughly to fine tilth. Incorporate Farmyard manure/compost (soil-test based).
growingGuide.irrigation: Maintain scheduled irrigation. Irrigation requirement classified as Medium.
growingGuide.fertilizer: Apply Urea @ 230.3 kg/ha in split applications (Basal + Top dressing). N-P-K target: 106:45:48 kg/ha.
growingGuide.plantProtection: Monitor weekly for regional pest thresholds. Use bio-pesticides (Neem oil 1500ppm) preventatively.
growingGuide.harvesting: Harvest at physiological maturity. Historical average yield: 3.3 tonnes/ha (1.7 t/acre).
